text:
Priya R.: quick sync — customer "X-Atlas" wants an embeddings endpoint that supports variable dims up to 4096, batch sizes up to 2k, and a 99.9% SLA. what can we realistically ship for MVP vs enterprise?
Tom B.: high-level: big dims + big batches = mem + throughput pressure. two pragmatic options: (A) support 4096 but auto-split large requests + require Dedicated for high throughput, (B) cap hosted dims at 2048 and offer 4096 only on Dedicated/Private.
Jin L.: agree with Tom. model choices matter: redwood-embed-medium (1024), redwood-embed-large (2048), redwood-embed-xlarge (4096, higher mem). default for hosted should be 2048 — best perf/cost tradeoff.
Marta S.: customers care about response shape. some want minimal vectors-only (for bulk indexing), others want per-item metadata. we should support both via response_format.
Tom B.: proposed API shape:
```json
POST /v1/embeddings
{ "model": "redwood-embed-large", "input": ["..."], "response_format": "compact|verbose" }
```
compact -> {"vectors": [[...],[...]]}
verbose -> {"items": [{"id":"...","vector":[...],"metadata":{}},...]}
Jin L.: batching policy: hosted auto-splits requests >512 items (configurable per-tenant). large requests get split into multi-batch jobs with headers to indicate batch progress. also add server-side limits: max 2048 items per call on hosted by default. Dedicated can increase to 2k.
Priya R.: launch criteria suggestion: MVP = support dims [1024,2048], batch up to 512, both response_format modes, docs + SDK examples, beta with 3 customers. Enterprise/Dedicated = add 4096 dims, batch 2k, SLA + throughput configs.
EvalBot: perf-run: hosted redwood-embed-large (2048) @ batch=512 median latency 210ms, p95 480ms, memory per worker ~28GB on g5.2xlarge.
Marta S.: we should expose fallback policy in headers/body when we auto-split or downgrade a model (e.g., if xlarge not available fallback to large). example header: `x-embedding-fallback: redwood-embed-large` and `x-batch-count: 4`.
Tom B.: need a tight error contract: partial failures return 207 Multi-Status with per-item error messages. avoid silent drops.
Jin L.: infra action: add tracing tags for batch_id, split_index, model_variant so we can correlate latency regressions. will prototype.
Priya R.: product action items: write spec for response_format, list supported dims per deployment, document fallback semantics, add migration notes for customers using fixed vector arrays.
Tom B.: I'll draft RFC this week with perf numbers and operator controls (max_batch, max_dims per tenant).
Jin L.: will validate memory profiles and add perf matrix by EOD tomorrow.
Marta S.: I'll prepare SDK examples for both compact+verbose and a migration guide for customers relying on flat arrays.
Priya R.: thanks — follow-up meeting next Tue 10am. @Tom B. ping when RFC ready :thumbsup:
